summary: @davewiner I could find no official announcement. @medium did note they pulled official support for the @WordPrsss plugin, I can't find any publishing recipes in IFTT, and all third party developers I know have said API access cut off.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: @davewiner I could find no official announcement. @medium did note they pulled official support for the @WordPrsss plugin, I can't find any publishing recipes in IFTT, and all third party developers I know have said API access cut off.
